issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation adds a negation ('không' - not) that is not present in the Greek text. The Greek 'ηπειθησαν' means 'obeyed,' but the Vietnamese renders it as 'đã không vâng lời' (did not obey).

The Vietnamese translation changes the causal relationship. The Greek 'ινα' (so that/in order that) indicates the purpose of their obedience, but the addition of 'nhờ' (thanks to/by means of) in the Vietnamese shifts the structure significantly.
